title: Why do cats act so weird? - Tony Buffington
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】為什麼貓的行為如此奇怪？ ——託尼·布芬頓（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Why do cats do that?
cues.en: Why do cats do that?
cues.zh: 為什麼貓咪會那麼做？

cues.text: They're cute, they're lovable, and judging by the 26 billions views of over 2 million YouTube videos
cues.en: They're cute, they're lovable, and judging by the 26 billions views of over 2 million YouTube videos
cues.zh: 牠們很可愛、討人喜歡 根據 Youtube 超過兩百萬部影片， 總計兩百六十億的觀看次數

cues.text: of them pouncing, bouncing, climbing, cramming, stalking, clawing,
cues.en: of them pouncing, bouncing, climbing, cramming, stalking, clawing,
cues.zh: 是關於貓咪......猛撲 跳躍 攀爬 擠進小空間 偷偷摸摸 抓撓 喵喵叫

cues.text: chattering, and purring, one thing is certain: cats are very entertaining.
cues.en: chattering, and purring, one thing is certain: cats are very entertaining.
cues.zh: 抓撓 喵喵叫 以及咕嚕作響 我們可以確定： 貓咪非常有趣

cues.text: These somewhat strange feline behaviors, both amusing and baffling,
cues.en: These somewhat strange feline behaviors, both amusing and baffling,
cues.zh: 貓咪非常有趣 這些貓科動物的奇怪行為 既有趣又讓人感到困惑

cues.text: leave many of us asking, "Why do cats do that?"
cues.en: leave many of us asking, "Why do cats do that?"
cues.zh: 既有趣又讓人感到困惑 讓我們不禁納悶： 「為什麼貓咪要那麼做？」

cues.text: Throughout time, cats were simultaneously solitary predators of smaller animals
cues.en: Throughout time, cats were simultaneously solitary predators of smaller animals
cues.zh: 長久以來， 貓咪既是小動物的獨行掠食者 卻也是大型肉食動物的獵物

cues.text: and prey for larger carnivores.
cues.en: and prey for larger carnivores.
cues.zh: 長久以來， 貓咪既是小動物的獨行掠食者 卻也是大型肉食動物的獵物 由於同時為掠食者與獵物

cues.text: As both predator and prey, survival of their species depended on crucial instinctual behaviors
cues.en: As both predator and prey, survival of their species depended on crucial instinctual behaviors
cues.zh: 由於同時為掠食者與獵物 貓咪物種的生存 取決於其關鍵的本能行為 這些至今我們仍可在 野貓或家貓身上看到

cues.text: which we still observe in wild and domestic cats today.
cues.en: which we still observe in wild and domestic cats today.
cues.zh: 這些至今我們仍可在 野貓或家貓身上看到 或許你家養的 Grizmo 有些令人費解的行為

cues.text: While the feline actions of your house cat Grizmo might seem perplexing,
cues.en: While the feline actions of your house cat Grizmo might seem perplexing,
cues.zh: 這些至今我們仍可在 野貓或家貓身上看到 或許你家養的 Grizmo 有些令人費解的行為

cues.text: in the wild, these same behaviors, naturally bred into cats for millions of years,
cues.en: in the wild, these same behaviors, naturally bred into cats for millions of years,
cues.zh: 或許你家養的 Grizmo 有些令人費解的行為 然而在野外，這些相同的行為 經過數百萬年自然的演化 可以讓 Grizmo 成為一隻超級貓

cues.text: would make Grizmo a super cat.
cues.en: would make Grizmo a super cat.
cues.zh: 可以讓 Grizmo 成為一隻超級貓 由於牠們獨特的肌肉構造與絕佳的平衡感

cues.text: Enabled by their unique muscular structure and keen balancing abilities,
cues.en: Enabled by their unique muscular structure and keen balancing abilities,
cues.zh: 由於牠們獨特的肌肉構造與絕佳的平衡感 貓咪可以爬到高處有利點 瞭望牠們的領土

cues.text: cats climbed to high vantage points to survey their territory
cues.en: cats climbed to high vantage points to survey their territory
cues.zh: 貓咪可以爬到高處有利點 瞭望牠們的領土 和找到野外的獵物

cues.text: and spot prey in the wild.
cues.en: and spot prey in the wild.
cues.zh: 貓咪可以爬到高處有利點 瞭望牠們的領土 和找到野外的獵物

cues.text: Grizmo doesn't need these particular skills to find and hunt down dinner
cues.en: Grizmo doesn't need these particular skills to find and hunt down dinner
cues.zh: 和找到野外的獵物 Grizmo 無須用到這些特殊技巧 去搜尋及追捕今天餐盤裡的晚餐

cues.text: in her food bowl today, but instinctually, viewing the living room from the top of the bookcase
cues.en: in her food bowl today, but instinctually, viewing the living room from the top of the bookcase
cues.zh: Grizmo 無須用到這些特殊技巧 去搜尋及追捕今天餐盤裡的晚餐 然而本能地從書架上瞭望整個客廳 這正是牠演化獲得的能力

cues.text: is exactly what she has evolved to do.
cues.en: is exactly what she has evolved to do.
cues.zh: 這正是牠演化獲得的能力

cues.text: As wild predators, cats are opportunistic and hunt whenever prey is available.
cues.en: As wild predators, cats are opportunistic and hunt whenever prey is available.
cues.zh: 這正是牠演化獲得的能力 作為野外掠食者 只要有機會貓咪隨時準備獵捕食物 由於大部分的獵物都很小

cues.text: Since most cat prey are small, cats in the wild needed to eat many times each day,
cues.en: Since most cat prey are small, cats in the wild needed to eat many times each day,
cues.zh: 由於大部分的獵物都很小 野貓每天都要進食很多次

cues.text: and use a stalk, pounce, kill, eat strategy to stay fed.
cues.en: and use a stalk, pounce, kill, eat strategy to stay fed.
cues.zh: 野貓每天都要進食很多次 並使用潛近、猛撲、獵殺、吃掉 的策略以獲得食物

cues.text: This is why Grizmo prefers to chase and pounce on little toys
cues.en: This is why Grizmo prefers to chase and pounce on little toys
cues.zh: 並使用潛近、猛撲、獵殺、吃掉 的策略以獲得食物 這就是為什麼 Grizmo 喜歡追逐、猛撲小玩具

cues.text: and eat small meals over the course of the day and night.
cues.en: and eat small meals over the course of the day and night.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼 Grizmo 喜歡追逐、猛撲小玩具 每天少量多餐的原因

cues.text: Also, small prey tend to hide in tiny spaces in their natural environments,
cues.en: Also, small prey tend to hide in tiny spaces in their natural environments,
cues.zh: 同時，野外獵物喜歡躲藏在狹小的空間內

cues.text: so one explanation for Grizmo's propensity to reach into containers and openings
cues.en: so one explanation for Grizmo's propensity to reach into containers and openings
cues.zh: 同時，野外獵物喜歡躲藏在狹小的空間內 因而一種解釋關於 Grizmo 躲在容器及空隙裡的習性

cues.text: is that she is compelled by the same curiosity that helped ensure the continuation of her species for millions of years before.
cues.en: is that she is compelled by the same curiosity that helped ensure the continuation of her species for millions of years before.
cues.zh: 因而一種解釋關於 Grizmo 躲在容器及空隙裡的習性 是被相同的好奇心所驅使 這好奇心使貓咪得以延續幾百萬年

cues.text: In the wild, cats needed sharp claws for climbing, hunting, and self-defense.
cues.en: In the wild, cats needed sharp claws for climbing, hunting, and self-defense.
cues.zh: 這好奇心使貓咪得以延續幾百萬年 在野外，貓咪需要磨利爪子 以便攀爬、獵捕和自我防衛

cues.text: Sharpening their claws on nearby surfaces kept them conditioned and ready,
cues.en: Sharpening their claws on nearby surfaces kept them conditioned and ready,
cues.zh: 在野外，貓咪需要磨利爪子 以便攀爬、獵捕和自我防衛 在附近物體表面上磨利爪子 讓自己隨時準備就緒、 協助伸展牠們背部與腿部的肌肉

cues.text: helped stretch their back and leg muscles, and relieve some stress, too.
cues.en: helped stretch their back and leg muscles, and relieve some stress, too.
cues.zh: 協助伸展牠們背部與腿部的肌肉 同時也釋放壓力

cues.text: So, it's not that Grizmo hates your couch, chair, ottoman,
cues.en: So, it's not that Grizmo hates your couch, chair, ottoman,
cues.zh: 同時也釋放壓力 所以，Grizmo 並不是討厭你的沙發 椅子 軟墊座椅

cues.text: pillows, curtains, and everything else you put in her environment.
cues.en: pillows, curtains, and everything else you put in her environment.
cues.zh: 軟墊座椅 枕頭 窗簾 以及在牠四周所放的任何物品 牠把那些東西抓成碎屑 只是為了維持爪子鋒利

cues.text: She's ripping these things to shreds and keeping her claws in tip-top shape
cues.en: She's ripping these things to shreds and keeping her claws in tip-top shape
cues.zh: 牠把那些東西抓成碎屑 只是為了維持爪子鋒利

cues.text: because this is exactly what her ancestors did in order to survive.
cues.en: because this is exactly what her ancestors did in order to survive.
cues.zh: 牠把那些東西抓成碎屑 只是為了維持爪子鋒利 因為這正是其祖先為了生存而做的事

cues.text: As animals that were preyed upon, cats evolved to not get caught,
cues.en: As animals that were preyed upon, cats evolved to not get caught,
cues.zh: 因為這正是其祖先為了生存而做的事 身為在野外被獵捕的動物 貓咪演化出不易被捕捉的技能

cues.text: and in the wild, the cats that were the best at avoiding predators thrived.
cues.en: and in the wild, the cats that were the best at avoiding predators thrived.
cues.zh: 貓咪演化出不易被捕捉的技能 在野外， 最善於躲避天敵的貓咪 才能茁壯成長

cues.text: So at your house today, Grizmo is an expert at squeezing into small spaces
cues.en: So at your house today, Grizmo is an expert at squeezing into small spaces
cues.zh: 在野外， 最善於躲避天敵的貓咪 才能茁壯成長 所以現在在你家裡 Grizmo 是擠進狹小空間的能手

cues.text: and seeking out and hiding in unconventional spots.
cues.en: and seeking out and hiding in unconventional spots.
cues.zh: 並擅長找出及藏匿在不尋常的地點

cues.text: It also explains why she prefers a clean and odor-free litter box.
cues.en: It also explains why she prefers a clean and odor-free litter box.
cues.zh: 並擅長找出及藏匿在不尋常的地點 這也解釋為何牠偏好乾淨、 無異味的小盒子

cues.text: That's less likely to give away her location to any predators
cues.en: That's less likely to give away her location to any predators
cues.zh: 這樣比較不會向天敵暴露牠的地點 這些天敵可能正在附近嗅探

cues.text: that may be sniffing around nearby.
cues.en: that may be sniffing around nearby.
cues.zh: 這些天敵可能正在附近嗅探 考量所有我們對於貓咪的瞭解

cues.text: Considering everything we do know about cats, it seems that one of their most predominate behaviors
cues.en: Considering everything we do know about cats, it seems that one of their most predominate behaviors
cues.zh: 這些天敵可能正在附近嗅探 考量所有我們對於貓咪的瞭解 似乎牠們最常見的行為 ── 咕嚕聲 仍是最神秘的其中一種

cues.text: is still one of the most mysterious.
cues.en: is still one of the most mysterious.
cues.zh: 仍是最神秘的其中一種

cues.text: Cats may purr for any number of reasons, such as happiness,
cues.en: Cats may purr for any number of reasons, such as happiness,
cues.zh: 仍是最神秘的其中一種 貓咪可因為許多原因而發出咕嚕聲 例如開心 壓力

cues.text: stress, and hunger.
cues.en: stress, and hunger.
cues.zh: 壓力 及飢餓時

cues.text: But curiously, the frequency of their purrs, between 25 and 150 hertz,
cues.en: But curiously, the frequency of their purrs, between 25 and 150 hertz,
cues.zh: 及飢餓時 但奇怪的是，貓咪咕嚕的頻率 介於 25~150 赫茲之間 是一個可以促進組織再生的頻率範圍

cues.text: is within a range that can promote tissue regeneration.
cues.en: is within a range that can promote tissue regeneration.
cues.zh: 是一個可以促進組織再生的頻率範圍 所以 Grizmo 的咕嚕聲 不只使牠成為絕佳的午覺夥伴

cues.text: So while her purring makes Grizmo an excellent nap companion, it is also possible that her purr is healing her muscles and bones,
cues.en: So while her purring makes Grizmo an excellent nap companion, it is also possible that her purr is healing her muscles and bones,
cues.zh: 是一個可以促進組織再生的頻率範圍 所以 Grizmo 的咕嚕聲 不只使牠成為絕佳的午覺夥伴 同時也能治療牠的肌肉與骨骼 甚至是你的

cues.text: and maybe even yours, too.
cues.en: and maybe even yours, too.
cues.zh: 甚至是你的 貓咪不斷的進化

cues.text: They developed through time as both solitary predators that hunted and killed to eat,
cues.en: They developed through time as both solitary predators that hunted and killed to eat,
cues.zh: 甚至是你的 貓咪不斷的進化 既是獵殺進食的獨行掠食者

cues.text: and stealthy prey that hid and escaped to survive.
cues.en: and stealthy prey that hid and escaped to survive.
cues.zh: 既是獵殺進食的獨行掠食者 也是藏匿逃脫以求生存的隱秘獵物

cues.text: So cats today retain many of the same instincts that allowed them to thrive in the wild for millions of years.
cues.en: So cats today retain many of the same instincts that allowed them to thrive in the wild for millions of years.
cues.zh: 也是藏匿逃脫以求生存的隱秘獵物 所以至今貓咪仍保留許多本能 讓牠們能持續在野外生存幾百萬年

cues.text: This explains some of their seemingly strange behaviors.
cues.en: This explains some of their seemingly strange behaviors.
cues.zh: 這能解釋部分牠們令人困惑的行為 對貓咪而言，我們的家就像牠們的叢林

cues.text: To them, our homes are their jungles.
cues.en: To them, our homes are their jungles.
cues.zh: 這能解釋部分牠們令人困惑的行為 對貓咪而言，我們的家就像牠們的叢林

cues.text: But if this is the case, in our own cat's eyes, who are we?
cues.en: But if this is the case, in our own cat's eyes, who are we?
cues.zh: 對貓咪而言，我們的家就像牠們的叢林 但如果是這樣，在我們貓咪的眼裡 我們是什麼呢？

cues.text: Big, dumb, hairless cats competing with them for resources?
cues.en: Big, dumb, hairless cats competing with them for resources?
cues.zh: 我們是什麼呢？ 是與牠們競爭資源的 巨大、愚蠢、無毛怪貓？

cues.text: Terribly stupid predators they're able to outsmart every day?
cues.en: Terribly stupid predators they're able to outsmart every day?
cues.zh: 每天可以輕鬆應對的愚蠢天敵？

cues.text: Or maybe they think we're the prey.
cues.en: Or maybe they think we're the prey.
cues.zh: 每天可以輕鬆應對的愚蠢天敵？ 或也許牠們覺得我們是獵物
